Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ReMPCA 0.1.0

First CRAN release.

Bug fixes

  • Row-sparsity cross-validation now predicts the held-out columns with the least-squares loadings v = X'u / ||u||^2, as in the manuscript. Previously the scores were not normalized, which mis-scaled the CV error and led to over-sparse row scores whenever several row-sparsity levels were compared.
  • ReMPCA() with num_pcs > 1 now deflates the data by the estimated regularized component (Algorithm 1 of the accompanying paper) instead of by the leading unregularized singular component. Unpenalized fits are unchanged.
  • VarianceExplained is now computed from the estimated (regularized) loadings rather than from the unregularized singular vectors.
  • The one-standard-error rule for loading sparsity now uses the standard error of the K-fold CV mean (it previously used the standard deviation of the fold errors), and the row-sparsity tuning now honours cv.pick for both tuning orders (it was hard-coded to "min" when tuning_order = "Sparsity").
  • Cross-validation no longer resets the user’s random number generator (set.seed() inside the package); folds still use a fixed internal seed, so results are unchanged and reproducible. Empty folds (too many folds for the data size) no longer produce NA indices.
  • $ methods for all classes gave an error inside the error message (sprintf() was missing its argument).
  • [.hdClass returned a data frame labelled as hdClass; it now returns a valid hdClass matrix. [.imgClass collapsed all selected images into one row; *.imgClass returned a list-matrix; plot.imgClass() displayed images scrambled (they are vectorized row-wise but were rebuilt column-wise) and no longer waits for input in non-interactive sessions. [.fdClass and [.rdClass keep matrix structure and subset the grid points with the columns.
  • Internal fixes to roughness-matrix bookkeeping (opt_alpha_Omega_*) that did not affect fitted values.
  • Unknown sparse_tuning_type, smoothness_type, tuning_order, or cv.pick values now give an informative error.

Other changes

  • New argument verbose in ReMPCA(); progress messages can be suppressed.
  • Plot functions restore the user’s graphical parameters on exit.
  • With parallel = TRUE, the internal cluster uses at most min(6, detectCores()) workers.
  • The energydata data set now contains an object named energydata (previously appliance_dat) and is xz-compressed; read.data() can load it.
  • Documentation: return values and runnable examples for all exported functions, references, and a test suite.
  • Reproducibility scripts for the bike-sharing and appliances-energy applications in inst/reproducibility now use the packaged data, can be run from any working directory, and save the manuscript figures.
